state:
**Goal `growth-proof`, between Stage 2 and Stage 3.** No floor is carried.

Every bench under `benches/members/` has `// bench: complexity`, and `--record-perf` requires it (`measureOne` in `tools/nv/proofs/perf.ts`). `bun nv scaling --growth [filter...]` judges benches as the proof does, with callgrind off.

Callgrind now sets N: when callgrind's instructions settle a bench's ramp, `rampAt` records the batch as `Judged.threshold`, and `growthOf` lowers the bench's `iterations` to twice that batch with `withIterations`, written as `// bench: iterations N callgrind`. `measureOne` runs the growth first, so the record is taken at the new N. N is never raised. `benches/members/README.md` documents the `callgrind` note.

`bun nv scaling --iterations --sized` exists: it fails a flat bench whose N is more than twice the batch its ramp settled at (`oversized`), and prints the check's line when none is. Every bench still has its old N, so the check is red until the tree is lowered. `core/Str/length.nvs` settles at 1024 with N 400000, for example.

Gap records for benches whose growth cannot be proven yet: `data/gaps/nv/a-bench-cannot-ramp-an-input-fixed-outside-its-program.json` (20 benches) and `data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/bigint-division-and-decimal-text-grow-quadratically.json` (nine `Core\BigInt` benches).

The whole tree has not been run under `--growth` or `--sized` yet (about a thousand benches, release binary).

items.text: **Lower the tree's N.** Run `bun nv scaling --iterations --sized --jobs 4` (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:1137`) under `bun nv bg`, and for each bench it names set `// bench: iterations` and the closing literal to the N it prints. `withIterations` (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:209`) is the rewrite, without the `callgrind` note. Re-record the clock figures of the lowered benches in the same slice (`bun nv proofs --record-perf`). Split by area across subagents with worktrees. Spec: the goal's Stage 3, `rule:testing/member-perf-ledger`.

**`--budget`.** Add `bun nv scaling --budget` in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:1097` (`run`): the counted work of every bench at its N, stored in `docs/perf/bench-budget.json`, which may only go down except for a new bench's share or a raised N with a reason beside its line. Check `the-bench-tree-is-within-its-budget`.
**README wording.** `benches/members/README.md:78`: "Size it to run in well under a second" becomes "the smallest count that shows the growth".

**Sweep `--growth`.** Run `bun nv scaling --growth` (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:1050`) under `bun nv bg`, and fix each FAIL by correcting its class or its sibling, or add a gap marker. Can share the bg run with the first item.

backlog: Stage 4 (a change reruns the benches it reaches) and Stage 5 (skip what is already proven): their checks fail with "filters did not match any test files", because the tests are not written yet. Goal prose Stages 4 and 5.
Stage 6: `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` needs `## The growth proof`, which lists every bench that needed callgrind or stayed unclear. Goal prose Stage 6.
`core/BigInt/mul.scale.nvs` is unclear without callgrind. Its ladder is in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`.
